title: UCO Bank Recruitment 2026 – Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: UCO Bank has announced notification for Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate degree from recognized University. Last date to apply: 29-10-26.

fees.category: General, EWS and OBC - Male candidates
General, EWS and OBC - Female/Transgender candidates

dates.event: Online Registration & Fee Payment Last Date

howToApply: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) under the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registering on NATS, apply for the UCO Bank Apprenticeship Program on the NATS portal.
Candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC (info@bfsissc.com) inviting them to fill in detailed application information and make payment for the Online Examination at https://beep.bfsissc.com.
Pay the requisite non-refundable Application/Examination fee through ONLINE mode only from 14-10-2026 to 29-10-2026.
Appear for the Online Entrance Examination conducted by BFSI SSC on 07-11-2026 at 11 AM.
Candidates can apply for engagement in ONE State/UT only.
Keep the NATS Enrolment ID safe for all future correspondence.
No hard copy of application or documents is to be sent to the Bank’s office.

title: Spices Board Recruitment 2026 – Trainee (Development) Posts
shortInfo: Spices Board has announced notification for Trainee (Development) posts. Required qualification: B.Sc in Agri/Horti/Forestry/Bot/Micro/Biotech. Last date to apply: 19-10-26.
howToApply: Before appearing for the written test, candidates must ensure that the application is submitted online. Last date for submitting online application is 19.10.2026.
Eligible candidates shall submit the application online at http://spicesboard.in/recruitment/.
Candidates reporting after the specified time or failing to submit their application online will not be permitted to participate in the test.
Candidates are required to report at the venue at least 30 minutes prior to the scheduled time for certificate verification.
Candidates must bring all original documents and certificates, along with one set of self-attested copies each, pertaining to identity, age, and educational qualifications for verification purpose.
Those who have not received their final degree certificate yet need not appear for the test.
Before applying, candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria for the training as mentioned in the notification.
Those who have undergone training in any offices of Spices Board earlier need not apply again regardless of whether they have completed their training or not.
Candidates once selected will be required to undergo training in any of the offices of Spices Board under the mentioned region/regional office.
No TA/DA will be given to candidates who attend the Written Test.
Candidates are advised to check the Board’s website www.indianspices.com for updates and not to rely on information from third-party websites.
Candidates shall obtain the original Degree certificate within two years from the date of issue of Provisional Degree certificate.

title: AAI Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice Posts
shortInfo: AAI has announced notification for Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice posts. Required qualification: Graduate Degree / Diploma / ITI. Last date to apply: Update.
howToApply: Graduate/Diploma candidates must register on the NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in
ITI candidates must register on the NAPS portal: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in
After registration, search for the concerned AAI Establishment ID corresponding to your preferred location.
Submit the online application through the respective portal.
Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.
